transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer billing. My name is Daniel. How can I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Daniel. I am calling because S-Net attempted to take my direct debit payment on the twenty-third of the month, but my salary isn't paid into my account until the twenty-eighth!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into your billing schedule for you, Rachel. Before we inspect the billing ledger, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 19 Cambridge Terrace, Oxford, OX1 1RR. And the security question answer is my first school, St Ebbe's.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Rachel, that verifies your customer records. What is the account number listed on your invoice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The account number is SN-482-109-44. I am a single mother working NHS healthcare shifts, and having my bank charge a thirty pound unpaid transaction fee when every single penny is budgeted for groceries has left me completely distraught in tears this morning!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Looking at your ledger, your broadband service was activated on the twenty-third of August, so the billing engine defaulted to the twenty-third for your monthly direct debit collection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When I set this up with the sales representative, I specifically told them I get paid on the twenty-eighth and needed the bill taken on the twenty-ninth!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to make sure I understand the situation clearly: your monthly direct debit was scheduled for the twenty-third rather than your preferred date following your payday on the twenty-eighth, causing an unpaid transaction and bank penalty. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. And S-Net has also added a ten-pound late payment fee on top!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can immediately remove that ten-pound late payment fee from your account balance as a one-off goodwill gesture, Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for waiving that, but what about shifting the direct debit date permanently so this never happens again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously direct debit mandates cannot be edited instantly in the banking system, Rachel, because the BACS clearing house requires a statutory ten working day notice period to re-register mandate schedules.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So when will the new date actually take effect?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am submitting the BACS mandate modification form right now to shift your payment date to the first of every month, which falls safely after your payday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does that mean next month's payment will be taken on the first of December?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because of the ten working day BACS lead time, the mandate modification is currently pending bank confirmation. If BACS approval completes in time, it will take on the first; otherwise, next month may require a manual card payment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So it's not guaranteed to take automatically on the first of next month yet?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, it is pending formal bank confirmation from BACS, which takes up to ten working days to process through the banking clearing cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I understand. How will I pay this month's forty-pound broadband bill then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will place a temporary hold on your account collections until the twenty-eighth so your broadband service remains fully active without any restriction.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And on the twenty-eighth I can pay by debit card online?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. You can log into your S-Net customer portal on the twenty-eighth and pay the standard forty pounds by debit card with zero penalty.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me the breathing space I need until my salary arrives.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to check on your current broadband service, Rachel, is your internet connection working normally at home right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the wifi and internet have been working fine, it was just the billing surprise that stressed me out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this billing ticket, Rachel, and I have documented the date change request and collections hold on your file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Daniel. I'll make sure to log in on the twenty-eighth and pay the forty pounds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check if you want paperless billing e-invoices sent to your email address so you get a reminder five days in advance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please! An email notification five days before payment would be wonderful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have enabled the 5-day advance payment alert on your email profile, Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will keep me completely organized.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you also aware of our S-Net Social Tariff discount plan for healthcare workers and low-income families, Rachel?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I haven't heard of that! What does the Social Tariff offer?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It provides full 50 megabit broadband for just twenty pounds a month with zero price increases and no contract lock-in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Cutting my monthly broadband bill in half from forty pounds to twenty pounds would be an incredible financial help for our family budget and grocery shopping!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can upload a photograph or digital copy of your NHS hospital employment pay slip or Universal Credit confirmation letter directly through your online customer portal under the Tariff Options tab.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will take a clear photograph of my hospital nursing ID and monthly pay slip and upload them through the portal this evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our social support assessment team verifies submissions within two working days and adjusts your monthly charge immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is so good to know, thank you for telling me about that option.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under the Direct Debit Guarantee, you also retain statutory protection against any unauthorized banking debits.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my bank mentioned that scheme when I opened the current account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your account or billing that I can assist with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will I receive any debt collection letters in the post before the twenty-eighth? If a red warning letter arrives it will terrify my kids!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand that worry, Rachel. Because I have placed a formal collections suspension flag on your account, absolutely no automated reminder letters or debt notices will be issued.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is such a relief to hear, thank you so much for confirming that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We will ensure your account remains quiet and secure while you await your salary on the twenty-eighth.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I also set up a recurring calendar reminder from the S-Net portal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, on the portal Billing Overview page there is an 'Add to Google/Apple Calendar' button that syncs your upcoming invoice due dates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will click that button on my phone right after this call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That will ensure you receive reminders across all your personal devices.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Daniel, you've been very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can also contact our specialized NHS support desk directly if you ever need additional billing flexibility.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's wonderful that S-Net provides dedicated support for healthcare workers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We appreciate everything you do for the community, Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Daniel, that really means a lot.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a brief survey by SMS following this call; we would appreciate any feedback on the service provided today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will complete the survey. Thanks again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Rachel. Have a restful evening and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
